events.coordinate_convention: StatsBomb possession-oriented event coordinates; the team in possession attacks toward x=120
events.missing_location: Allowed; spatial calculations requiring a missing endpoint are omitted or remain zero according to the Python core.

three_sixty.out_of_bounds_policy: Preserve source coordinates; do not clip or use as event locations. The core uses the frames only for event-UUID linkage audit.

direction.documented_core_behavior: When a direction override is absent, the Python core fills the StatsBomb possession-oriented direction key with true.
direction.javascript_behavior: Match the documented Python behavior and report how many keys were explicit versus generated.
direction.false_override: Rejected because it would double-flip StatsBomb's already normalized coordinates.

null_semantics.blank_csv_cells: Treat as null in parity comparison.
null_semantics.missing_counter_key: Preserve as null in the JavaScript canonical row when the Python Counter-backed CSV cell is blank.
null_semantics.null_vs_zero: Never coerce; null and zero are distinct and must fail parity when they differ.
null_semantics.unsupported_inputs: Do not invent player aliases or minutes. Exclude FPL joins and per-90 features from this parity contract.

sequences.granularity: One row per match, period, possession ID, and possession team.

sequence_id.definition: The Python core's deterministic match_id:period:possession_id:team identifier.
sequence_id.aggregation: One identifier for the possession entity.

event_count.definition: Number of input events grouped into the possession.
event_count.aggregation: Count rows in the possession group.

duration_seconds.definition: Non-negative difference between the final and initial event minute/second clocks, rounded to two decimals.
duration_seconds.aggregation: Last event clock minus first event clock within the possession.

players.definition: Sorted unique non-empty event actor names joined by '|'; no names is null.
players.aggregation: Distinct actor names within the possession.

passes.definition: Number of events whose type is Pass.

completed_passes.definition: Passes with no truthy pass.outcome value, matching the Python core.
completed_passes.aggregation: Count completed passes within the possession.

carries.definition: Number of events whose type is Carry.

receipts.definition: Number of Ball Receipt* or Ball Receipt events.

pressured_events.definition: Count of events with a truthy under_pressure field.

pressured_receipts.definition: Count of receipt events with a truthy under_pressure field.

box_entries.definition: Pass or carry endpoints with x >= 102 and 18 <= y <= 62 after the core's direction transform.
box_entries.aggregation: Count qualifying endpoints within the possession; null if direction is unavailable.

final_third_entries.definition: Pass or carry endpoints with x >= 80 after the core's direction transform.
final_third_entries.aggregation: Count qualifying endpoints within the possession; null if direction is unavailable.

progressive_actions.definition: Pass or carry actions whose transformed endpoint is at least 10 x-units ahead of the transformed start.
progressive_actions.aggregation: Count qualifying actions within the possession; null if direction is unavailable.

shot_xg_reference_only.definition: Sum of StatsBomb shot.statsbomb_xg values; missing/falsy values contribute zero; rounded to six decimals.
shot_xg_reference_only.aggregation: Sum over Shot events in the possession; reference only, not a pre-shot feature.

mean_action_xt_gain.definition: Mean change in the same match-fitted 16x12 xT grid over eligible pass/carry actions, rounded to six decimals.
mean_action_xt_gain.aggregation: Arithmetic mean over valid action start/end pairs; null if none.

positive_action_xt_gain_sum.definition: Sum of positive changes in the same match-fitted 16x12 xT grid, rounded to six decimals.
positive_action_xt_gain_sum.aggregation: Sum max(0, action xT change) over valid action pairs; null if none.

direction_available.definition: Whether the core has a direction key for the possession's match, period, and team.

sequence_class.definition: shot_linked if any shot; otherwise non_shot_candidate when the core's spatial/pressure rule passes; otherwise other_possession.
sequence_class.aggregation: One rule-based class per possession; not a human-validated danger label.

unsupported_features: Any event-level feature not emitted by the Python core.

players.granularity: One row per StatsBomb player ID across exactly one isolated single-match run.

event_involvements.definition: Actor events counted by the Python core.
event_involvements.aggregation: Count actor events over the single-match run.

passes.definition: Pass events attributed to the event actor.
passes.aggregation: Count over the single-match run; null if the Counter key is never created.

completed_passes.definition: Passes without a truthy pass.outcome, attributed to the actor.
completed_passes.aggregation: Count over the single-match run; null if no actor pass exists.

box_entries.definition: Actor pass/carry endpoints in the core's box threshold after direction transform.
box_entries.aggregation: Count over the single-match run; sparse Counter blanks remain null.

final_third_entries.definition: Actor pass/carry endpoints with transformed x >= 80.
final_third_entries.aggregation: Count over the single-match run; sparse Counter blanks remain null.

progressive_actions.definition: Actor pass/carry actions advancing at least 10 transformed x-units.
progressive_actions.aggregation: Count over the single-match run; sparse Counter blanks remain null.

action_xt_gain_sum.definition: Sum of actor-attributed changes in the match-fitted xT grid.
action_xt_gain_sum.aggregation: Sum over valid actor pass/carry start/end pairs.

action_xt_gain_n.definition: Number of actor-attributed pass/carry pairs with valid xT start and end cells.

passes_received.definition: Pass recipient counts from the named pass.recipient field.
passes_received.aggregation: Count over the single-match run; null when never named as recipient.

pressured_passes_received.definition: Recipient counts for passes whose event has truthy under_pressure.
pressured_passes_received.aggregation: Count over the single-match run; sparse Counter blanks remain null.

receipts.definition: Ball Receipt* or Ball Receipt events attributed to the event actor.
receipts.aggregation: Count over the single-match run; null when no receipt event exists.

carries.definition: Carry events attributed to the event actor.
carries.aggregation: Count over the single-match run; null when no carry event exists.

sequences_involved.definition: Number of possession groups containing the player as an event actor.
sequences_involved.aggregation: Count once per actor per possession.

shot_linked_sequences.aggregation: Count once per actor per shot-linked possession.

non_shot_candidate_sequences.definition: Actor possessions classified non_shot_candidate by the rule-based core logic.
non_shot_candidate_sequences.aggregation: Count once per actor per candidate possession; not a human-validated danger label.

shots.definition: Shot events attributed to the event actor.
shots.aggregation: Count over the single-match run; null when no shot event exists.

shot_xg_reference_only.definition: Actor-attributed StatsBomb shot xG; missing/falsy xG contributes zero.
shot_xg_reference_only.aggregation: Sum over actor shot events; reference only.

mean_action_xt_gain.definition: action_xt_gain_sum divided by action_xt_gain_n, rounded to six decimals.
mean_action_xt_gain.aggregation: Mean over valid actor action pairs; null when none.

pressured_receipts.definition: Actor receipt events with truthy under_pressure.
pressured_receipts.aggregation: Count over the single-match run; sparse Counter blanks remain null.

statsbomb_player_name.definition: Display name attached to the numeric StatsBomb player ID in the source event; never used as the identity key.
statsbomb_player_name.aggregation: One display name per StatsBomb player ID within the isolated match run; conflicting names for one ID are rejected.

unsupported_features.reason: No verified player alias rows exist in data/player_id_map.csv.
No trusted minutes rows exist; the Python CLI's zero-minute fallback is not a valid comparable input.
The verified 360 freeze-frame entities have no player IDs or names.

xt_grid.granularity: One row per cell of the Python core's match-fitted 16x12 grid.

xT.definition: Value from the core's single-match empirical shot/move grid iteration, rounded to eight decimals.
xT.aggregation: One value per 16x12 grid cell; exploratory single-match baseline only.

unsupported_features: No calibration, predictive performance, FPL points, EV, EO, or CoVar interpretation.
